==Errors==
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=4m10s|text=4:10}} [[Egwene]] did not "follow" [[Moiraine]] and the boys to [[Baerlon]]. She was with them right from the start in [[Emond's Field]]. So was [[Thom Merrilin]]. Also, technically [[Rand]] was the only one who briefly met [[Fain]].
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=4m28s|text=4:28}} Basically everyone the Two Rivers group met knew they came with [[Moiraine]]. What [[Min]] knew (and [[Rand]] denied) was that Moiraine was [[Aes Sedai]] (and that her name was Moiraine).
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=6m30s|text=6:30}} "The [[Blue Ajah]]" refers collectively to the Blue Ajah organization. A single member may be referred to as "the Blue" or "the Blue Ajah sister", but never as "the Blue Ajah." Also, [[Moiraine]] knew [[Nynaeve]] could channel back when they first met in [[Emond's Field]]. She did not discover it en route to [[Caemlyn]]. Rather, that's when she revealed to ''Nynaeve'' that Nynaeve could channel. Also, Moiraine never decided to teach Nynaeve, though she did (sort of) convince her to learn.
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=6m40s|text=6:40}} There is no evidence [[Moiraine]] had anything to do with [[Nynaeve]] skipping over the [[novice]] stage.{{verify}} Certainly she never had any dialogue or POV thought to that effect. [[Siuan Sanche]] is the one who made that decision.
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=11m14s|text=11:14}} The [[Eye of the World]] was not the "source" of ''[[saidin]]''. That would be the [[True Source]], a metaphysical location. The Eye was merely a pool of "the essence" of ''saidin''. Basically, it stored some clean ''saidin'', but was absolutely not the "source" of ''saidin''.

==Nitpicks==
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=5m22s|text=5:22}} The pictured boat is definitely not the [[Spray]] ([[Bayle Domon|Bayle Domon's]] ship). It had masts and a cabin; it wasn't some basic flat-bottomed craft.
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=6m10s|text=6:10}} "Shadowfriend" is not a term used within the Wheel of Time. The [[Aiel]] say "[[Shadowrunner]]" and the rest say "[[Darkfriend]]". More importantly, while the [[Whitecloaks]] certainly held [[Perrin|Perrin's]] eyes against him, he ''did'' kill two of them at their first encounter. That was the bigger reason for naming him a Darkfriend.
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=7m20s|text=7:20}} Technically, "the [[bard]]" did tell [[Rand]] and [[Mat]] to seek out [[The Queen's Blessing]], but it feels like there's some missing content here. In the book, his past as a bard was technically mentioned in [[Thom|Thom's]] introduction, but the boys thought of him as a [[gleeman]], not a bard. In this video, I don't think a connection between Thom and being a bard has been established.
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=8m32s|text=8:32}} Is "Sons" supposed to refer to the [[Children of the Light]]? Because they're never called the "sons" in the books or even amongst the fandom, despite being completely male. That said, "my son" is used as an address to lesser ranked Whitecloaks by some Whitecloak leadership (e.g. [[Asunawa]]).
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=9m24s|text=9:24}} The wording here makes it sound like multiple [[Blue Ajah|Blues]] tried to [[Healing|Heal]] [[Mat]] while they were in [[Caemlyn]]. It was only [[Moiraine]]. When multiple [[Aes Sedai]] were involved in Healing Mat later in [[Fal Dara]] and then [[Tar Valon]], it was not limited to Blue Ajah sisters.
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=9m56s|text=9:56}} Nitpick, but the [[Eye of the World]] did not appear in the boys' dreams. It was simply mentioned by [[Ba'alzamon]].
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=10m00s|text=10:00}} The [[Ways]] are never referred to as "the Roads." Also, "[[Ogier]]" is both singular and plural - "Ogiers" is not a word.
# {{YTlink|url=https://youtu.be/cM2s8IcUMYU?t=14m16s|text=14:16}} [[Moiraine]] doesn't tell [[Rand]] he's the [[Dragon]] until later, when they've all spent weeks back at [[Fal Dara]].
{{notes}}
